manuscripts.notes: Vogelzang and Annus claim that Sm.1807 is a neo-babylonian tablet. This is evidently not the case, see e.g. the KA sign in r 7ʹ. The script is rather similar to NinMA1, cf. the HI-group with four instead of three Winkelhaken. The script might be better desribed as early neo-assyrian than middle assyrian. Were it not for the omission of l. 99 in NinMA1 the fragments could in fact belong to the same original tablet.
